description: Tic Tac Toe against an unbeatable minimax AI — or a friend in two-player mode.

faqs.a: It uses the minimax algorithm, which explores every possible game. Played perfectly it can never lose — the best you can do is a draw.
Yes — switch to “Two players” and pass the device back and forth. X always moves first.
Minimax evaluates the whole game tree (at most a few thousand positions), so the move is instant.
faqs.q: Why is the computer's move instant?

howto: Click a square — X moves first.
The AI answers with the perfect minimax move.
Wins, draws and the winning line are tracked below.
